description: Fleet publisher for timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo: branch creation, file publication, PR creation and merge on an ephemeral GitHub App installation token — its own rate-limit bucket, separate from the owner PAT bucket, so publishes and merges survive PAT exhaustion. Write counterpart to the read-only Termux Fleet Collector; part of the fleet's automated revision-adaptive allocation process (docs/ops/QUOTA-ALLOCATION-PLANNING.md).
name: Termux Fleet Publisher
